final: WITH m AS (SELECT t.equipstatus AS es, s.pulsepersec AS p FROM signals s JOIN telescopes t ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref COLLATE BINARY), g AS (SELECT es, AVG(p) AS a FROM m GROUP BY es), o AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS oa FROM g), k AS (SELECT g.es AS es, g.a AS a, g.a - o.oa AS d1 FROM g JOIN o ON o.oa IS NOT NULL WHERE g.a > o.oa), r AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS ra FROM k), f AS (SELECT k.es AS es, k.a AS a, k.d1 AS d1, k.a - r.ra AS d2 FROM k JOIN r ON r.ra IS NOT NULL WHERE k.a > r.ra) SELECT AVG(a) AS avg_status_avg, AVG(d1) AS avg_diff_first, AVG(d2) AS avg_diff_second FROM f
